scenes.title: Current flows through the moving coil

vo.text: An electric motor turns electrical energy into rotation to power fans, tools, and machines.
vo.speak: An electric motor turns electrical energy into rotation to power fans, tools, and machines.

vo.text: Inside the motor, the essential interaction is between electric current and a magnetic field.
vo.speak: Inside the motor, the essential interaction is between electric current and a magnetic field.

vo.text: Two fixed magnets create a magnetic field across the motor's central space.
vo.speak: Two fixed magnets create a magnetic field across the motor's central space.

vo.text: A wire coil sits in that field, and the motor sends electric current through the coil.
vo.speak: A wire coil sits in that field, and the motor sends electric current through the coil.

vo.text: Current in the coil produces opposite forces on its two sides, creating a turning force called torque.
vo.speak: Current in the coil produces opposite forces on its two sides, creating a turning force called torque.

vo.text: Those forces rotate the coil and the shaft attached to it.
vo.speak: Those forces rotate the coil and the shaft attached to it.

vo.text: But the coil would stall if the current stayed in the same direction.
vo.speak: But the coil would stall if the current stayed in the same direction.

vo.text: A split-ring commutator reverses the current every half turn, keeping the torque in the same rotational direction.
vo.speak: A split-ring commutator reverses the current every half turn, keeping the torque in the same rotational direction.

vo.text: So the motor keeps spinning by repeatedly switching the coil's current so magnetic forces continue turning its shaft.
vo.speak: So the motor keeps spinning by repeatedly switching the coil's current so magnetic forces continue turning its shaft.
